control_light.policy: Canonical control_device permission plus source/target alias denial
control_light.lifetime: Inherited target cooperative deadline; caller-owned cancellation

plan_cad_changes.caller: Owner renderer via typed proposal transport
plan_cad_changes.effects: Optional provider returns bounded field edits for review
plan_cad_changes.policy: Shared generate_cad and explicit tool deny/approval; post-provider owner and base recheck
plan_cad_changes.lifetime: 40 second dispatcher timeout; owned provider/task cleanup

speech_capture.policy: Shared start_audio permission; independent speech_capture denial; owner/project recheck after approval
speech_capture.context: Origin renderer SID, pinned owner, captured project and conversation UUID
speech_capture.lifetime: One bounded turn; pending approval and turn cancel on origin disconnect/core close/restriction

browser_inspect.context: Captured owner, project and origin SID; no persisted results
browser_inspect.effects: One bounded public HTTPS GET inspection; page text is untrusted
browser_inspect.policy: Shared run_web_agent approval/denial; no provider, scripts, credentials or actions
browser_inspect.lifetime: 25 second owned worker deadline; cancel/disconnect/resource/quit kills process tree

ask_brain.policy: Normal brain turn in the session's desktop conversation; every tool through the shared ToolDispatcher with unchanged approvals (tool_confirmation_request to the origin SID); session authorization before and after approval

end_conversation.policy: Ends only the calling hands-free session after the goodbye turn

/telephony/voice/inbound.authentication: Separate 127.0.0.1 gateway (default port 8790, never the core port) reached only through the Cloudflare named tunnel; X-Twilio-Signature (HMAC-SHA1 with the Twilio Auth Token) over calls.public_base_url + exact path and query + sorted form params, constant-time; AccountSid must match; 403 otherwise
/telephony/voice/inbound.effects: Loop guard first (JARVIS's own number or withheld caller forwarded from the owner -> <Reject/> and internal owner_unreachable event); kill switch / no call agent -> voicemail or hang up per calls.when_disabled; otherwise <Connect><Stream> with a 2-minute single-use stream token bound to the CallSid

/telephony/voice/outbound.authentication: Separate 127.0.0.1 gateway (default port 8790, never the core port) reached only through the Cloudflare named tunnel; X-Twilio-Signature (HMAC-SHA1 with the Twilio Auth Token) over calls.public_base_url + exact path and query + sorted form params, constant-time; AccountSid must match; 403 otherwise; plus a single-use 2-minute ticket in the query bound to JARVIS's own outbound call record (To/From/CallSid rechecked)
/telephony/voice/outbound.effects: <Connect><Stream> for a call JARVIS placed (owner, or a third party under a consumed one-use grant); hang up when calls are off

/telephony/status.authentication: Separate 127.0.0.1 gateway (default port 8790, never the core port) reached only through the Cloudflare named tunnel; X-Twilio-Signature (HMAC-SHA1 with the Twilio Auth Token) over calls.public_base_url + exact path and query + sorted form params, constant-time; AccountSid must match; 403 otherwise
/telephony/status.effects: Record call status for JARVIS's outbound calls and emit an internal telephony.call_status event; 204

/telephony/media.authentication: Upgrade X-Twilio-Signature over the public wss:// (or https://) stream URL with no params, else HTTP 403; start message must carry the configured AccountSid and redeem the single-use stream token for its CallSid and direction
/telephony/media.effects: Bidirectional Twilio Media Stream (mu-law 8 kHz) bridged to CallAudioSession for the call agent; ends the call when the agent hangs up

record_message.target: CallAgent: stored in the call record's fields.message (CallRecords, DPAPI, 7 days)
record_message.schema: name 1-80, reason 1-300, urgency low|normal|urgent, callback_number (confirmed digit by digit; E.164, Malaysian national numbers get +60, or "none"), message 1-1000
record_message.policy: Validated with pydantic; invalid arguments return is_error to the model and record nothing; the latest valid call wins

record_owner_decision.mode: owner_briefing (outbound to the owner's number only)
record_owner_decision.target: CallAgent: fields.decision; a confirmed callback issues ONE C1 grant (TelephonyService.grants.issue) for the caller's number and the approved callback brief's hash
record_owner_decision.schema: action callback|ignore|owner_handles, message_for_caller (required for callback, 1-500), confirmed: bool
record_owner_decision.policy: confirmed=false returns the read-back; confirmed=true is refused unless the same action and message were read back first and the owner's words since contain an explicit yes and no negation; one decision per briefing; with calls.briefing_pin set, refused until verify_pin succeeds

verify_pin.mode: owner_briefing, only when calls.briefing_pin is set
verify_pin.target: CallAgent: constant-time compare with calls.briefing_pin; on success returns the call details
verify_pin.policy: The PIN is never in the instruction, logs or record (spoken digits are redacted from captions); the call details reach the model only after a match; three failures end the call

record_outcome.mode: approved_callback, task (outbound; each needs a one-use grant bound to the number and brief hash, consumed by place_call)
record_outcome.schema: status delivered|confirmed|declined|no_answer|needs_owner, details 0-1000, confirmed_time HH:MM optional (task calls, C4)
record_outcome.policy: Validated with pydantic; is_error on invalid arguments

end_call.target: CallAgent: hangs up after the current utterance (final Media Stream mark played, 15 s cap)
end_call.policy: Ends only this call; also used for the 10-minute limit, silence and budget wrap-up
